$comment: Withholding tax on compensation tables effective Jan 1, 2023 (RR 11-2018 as amended; BIR revised withholding tax tables). Each bracket: floor (compensation exceeds), base tax, rate on excess over floor. Draft pending research reconciliation.

legalBasis: RR 11-2018 Annex E (Revised Withholding Tax Table effective Jan 1, 2023)
NIRC Sec 24(A)(2)(a) & Sec 79, as amended by RA 10963
tables.notes: Confirmed unchanged through Aug 2026 (no 2024-2026 issuance revised Annex E) and matched against multiple independent sources, including a worked example (₱50,000/mo → ₱1,875 + 20% × ₱16,667 = ₱5,208.40). Withholding applies to taxable compensation after mandatory SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG employee shares and non-taxable benefits. Pending House/Senate bracket bills would change these tables if enacted (TY2027 earliest).

items.benefit: Employee achievement awards (cash/GC allowed since RR 4-2025)

items.ceiling: 30% of regional basic minimum wage per day

deMinimis.notes: RR 29-2025 RAISED several ceilings effective Jan 6, 2026 (rice ₱2,000→₱2,500, uniforms ₱6,000→₱8,000, medical ₱10,000→₱12,000, gifts ₱5,000→₱6,000, laundry ₱300→₱400, awards ₱10,000→₱12,000). Amounts within ceilings are tax-free; the excess counts toward the ₱90,000 other-benefits cap. Verify the exact RR text before payroll use.

minimumWageReference.notes: Region-specific — every region has its own wage order and rates. Shown only as an NCR reference for the minimum-wage-earner exemption; check your RTWPB's current order.

value.method: graduated table on annualized taxable compensation; December adjustment trues up the year

legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.79(B)(5)(b), as amended by RR 11-2018
annualization.notes: On the last payroll of the year (or on termination), the employer computes tax on the full year's taxable compensation — including pay from a previous employer within the year — using the annual graduated table, and withholds or refunds the difference so total withheld equals annual tax due. Refunds of over-withholding are due to employees not later than January 25 of the following year.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 24(A)(2), as amended by RA 9504
mweExempt.notes: Statutory minimum wage earners are exempt from income tax on their SMW, plus holiday pay, overtime, night differential, and hazard pay — no withholding applies.
